payrollGuide.title: Set up payroll with formulas
payrollGuide.heading: Setting up payroll without a template
payrollGuide.intro: When there is no statutory template for your country — or you chose not to use one — you configure payroll yourself: each earning, deduction and employer charge is a pay component whose amount is a formula.
payrollGuide.step1: Open Payroll → Pay rules. The earnings, deductions and employer charges there are your pay components; add one for every tax, contribution and benefit you pay.
payrollGuide.step2: Give each component a rule: a formula that computes the amount for the pay period, built from the functions and variables below — for example #pct(#min(#grossSalary, 5000), 9.5) for a 9.5% contribution capped at 5,000.
payrollGuide.step3: For progressive income tax, use #band with your country's brackets (annualise monthly pay with × 12 and divide back when the brackets are annual), or set up tax brackets.
payrollGuide.step4: Use each rule's effective dates when rates change, so past periods keep the rates that applied then.
payrollGuide.step5: Run payroll for one period, compare the payslips with an amount you trust, then post.
payrollGuide.responsibility: You are responsible for the rates and ceilings you enter. Where Humano has a statutory template for your country, it keeps them up to date for you.
